phase_prompt.summary: Wole in his mature form, fully equipped with obsidian gear and bioluminescent glyphs.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic portrait of Wole, a venerable archivist from ancient Ethiopia, standing in a dimly lit underground chamber. He wears a basalt-stitched robe etched with glowing glyphs, a translucent quartz mask revealing bioluminescent circuitry, and carries an obsidian scepter with a crystal core. The scene is grounded in industrial mysticism, with dust motes floating in shafts of light, and the atmosphere feels heavy with ancient knowledge and incomprehensible technology.
